name: gastrack-root
description: GasTrack - Enterprise LPG Cylinder & Supply Chain Management System

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
